name: protocol-api
description: PROTOCOL backend: Lambda Web Function (Hono) + DynamoDB + Bedrock

scripts.dev: STORE=memory MOCK_AI=1 API_TOKEN=dev ALLOWED_ORIGINS=* AWS_LAMBDA_HTTP_ENDPOINT=127.0.0.1:3000 node src/index.js
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && echo "import './index.mjs';" > dist/index.js && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json
